subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------CRTF.PROG.
description: Chart on book p. 241 (WAC-39). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: DEC (decentralization) and INFO-DY. From DEC: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: PART (participation). From PART: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From INFO-DY: AF-TD (affinity tendencies). From AF-TD: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of" and EXT-DY (extended dynamics).
